name: Crossroads Tavern
author: voodoo573
description: A timber-floored common room with seven round tables, an L-shaped bar with stools, a row of barrels, a stone hearth, a staircase and a red rug by the front door. Doors on the south and west walls. 24 x 18 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Cosy tavern common room with bar, hearth, tables and stairs.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
